action: Medium Shot. Establishing framing of both performers side-by-side. Performer A is on the left, Performer B on the right. They sing Line 1 of the chorus as cinematic backlighting casts a neon glow on their hair.
micro_expressions: Performer A holds a dramatic, focused stare into the lens. Performer B delivers a warm dimpled smile directed slightly off-camera. Both articulate the words clearly.
lyric: We burn bright in the neon light

lyricParts.text: We burn bright in the neon light

action: Extreme Close-Up on Performer A. Her sharp features and jet-black hair frame the shot as neon lights cast high-contrast shadows. She delivers Line 2.
micro_expressions: Her expression shifts from fierce to a slight, confident smirk, maintaining intense eye contact with the viewer.

action: Close-Up on Performer B. Her voluminous dark wavy curls bounce in frame as she sings Line 3. Light reflects off her ruby-red satin corset.
micro_expressions: Her dimpled smile radiates pure summer pop energy.
lyric: Feel the beat, we're flying high

lyricParts.text: Feel the beat, we're flying high

action: Wide Shot. Studio lights pulse with the tempo. Both performers execute a synchronized choreography move, swaying their skirts and articulating Line 4 together, leaning toward the camera.
micro_expressions: Smiling and laughing in dynamic, friendly competition, displaying genuine joy.
